description: An accounting firm employs part time workers and full time workers. Full time workers work 8 hours per shift while part time workers work 4 hours per shift. In addition, full time workers are paid $300 per shift while part time workers are paid $100 per shift. Currently, the accounting firm has a project requiring 500 hours of labor. If the firm has a budget of $15000, how many of each type of worker should be scheduled to minimize the total number of workers.

FullTimeHoursPerShift.definition: The number of hours a full time worker works per shift

PartTimeHoursPerShift.definition: The number of hours a part time worker works per shift

FullTimePayPerShift.definition: The amount paid to a full time worker per shift

PartTimePayPerShift.definition: The amount paid to a part time worker per shift

LaborHoursRequired.definition: The total labor hours required for the project

TotalBudget.definition: The total budget available for labor costs

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of workers (full-time and part-time) scheduled"

constraints.description: 8 * (Number of full time workers) + 4 * (Number of part time workers) must be at least 500
300 * (Number of full time workers) + 100 * (Number of part time workers) must not exceed 15000
Number of full time workers and Number of part time workers must be non-negative integers

FullTimeWorkers.definition: The number of full time workers scheduled

PartTimeWorkers.definition: The number of part time workers scheduled
